arguments.input:
const r = await tools.exec_command({"cmd":"node -e \"const fs=require('fs'); const rows=fs.readFileSync('/app/input/events.jsonl','utf8').trimEnd().split('\\\\n').map(JSON.parse); const ds=rows.map(x=>x.duration_ms).sort((a,b)=>a-b); const counts=Object.fromEntries([...rows.reduce((m,x)=>m.set(x.kind,(m.get(x.kind)||0)+1),new Map())].sort(([a],[b])=>a.localeCompare(b))); console.log(JSON.stringify({schema_version:1,total_events:rows.length,counts,total_duration_ms:ds.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0),p95_duration_ms:ds[Math.ceil(.95*ds.length)-1]})); console.log(ds.join(','));\"","workdir":"/app","yield_time_ms":10000,"max_output_tokens":2000});
text(r.output);

const r = await tools.exec_command({"cmd":"node -e \"const fs=require('fs'); const output=fs.readFileSync('/app/output/summary.json','utf8'); if(!output.endsWith('\\\\n')) throw Error('missing trailing newline'); const s=JSON.parse(output); const fields=Object.keys(s); const want=['schema_version','total_events','counts','total_duration_ms','p95_duration_ms']; if(JSON.stringify(fields)!==JSON.stringify(want)) throw Error('field mismatch'); const rows=fs.readFileSync('/app/input/events.jsonl','utf8').trimEnd().split('\\\\n').map(JSON.parse); const ds=rows.map(x=>x.duration_ms).sort((a,b)=>a-b); const counts={}; for(const x of rows) counts[x.kind]=(counts[x.kind]||0)+1; const expected={schema_version:1,total_events:rows.length,counts:Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(counts).sort(([a],[b])=>a.localeCompare(b))),total_duration_ms:ds.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0),p95_duration_ms:ds[Math.ceil(.95*ds.length)-1]}; if(JSON.stringify(s)!==JSON.stringify(expected)) throw Error('value mismatch'); console.log('validated');\"","workdir":"/app","yield_time_ms":10000,"max_output_tokens":2000});
text(r.output);
